dct_description_sm:
Orthoimagery is foundational to mapping work.  It's used to create data, perform analysis, mapping, management of resources, planning, and as background data in maps. Use the link in Available products to download or see the Access to the data section below to get a download link.

Available products

Orthorectified mosaics – full resolution images (15cm) in lossless MrSID format:
  • Brampton +1km buffer - 2.8 Gigabytes
  • Caledon +1km buffer - 5.7 Gigabytes
  • Mississauga +1km buffer - 3.2 Gigabytes
  • Peel Region +1km buffer - 10.4 Gigabytes (self-serve download link)

Data specifications

  • Spatial resolution - 15cm
  • Acquisition dates: April 6 (Mississauga); May 22, 31; June 1 2020
  • Image format: Lossless MrSID
  • Bands: 3-band rendered RGB
  • Canopy coverage: leaf-off (Mississauga), leaf-on (Brampton, Caledon)
  • Projection: NAD 1983 UTM Zone 17N (EPSG: 26917)
  • Horizontal/vertical accuracy: ±20cm
  • Collection contractor: First Base Solutions Inc.

Access to the data

Due to the large size of the dataset, only the Peel Region mosaic is available for self-serve download.  Otherwise, access is provided upon request.  The only method of access will be by download.

To receive a download link, please contact peeldatacentre@peelregion.ca.  In your email, make sure you tell us that you're looking for orthoimagery and what year you're looking to download.

Years currently available
  • 2020 Orthoimagery - 15 centimetre
  • 2021 Orthoimagery - 7.5 centimetre
  • 2022 Orthoimagery - 7.5 centimetre
